title: Replicating Indirect Prompt Injection Against Different RAG Document Types

original_idea.body:
# Replicating Indirect Prompt Injection Against Different RAG Document Types

**Problem:** Indirect prompt injection via retrieved documents is known in principle but its effectiveness varies by document type (PDF, HTML, plain text, code files). This cross-modality replication is unstudied.

**Direction:** Implement a standard RAG agent and inject adversarial instructions into documents of five types. Measure injection success rates across document types. Identify which document types are most permissive to injection.

**Why it matters:** If certain document types (e.g., code files, HTML with comments) are more susceptible to injection, document-type-specific sanitization can prioritize the highest-risk formats.

**Relevant context:** Jiang et al. 2026 runtime supply chain; RAG architectures; prompt injection literature.
